payout_quote: Offer valid through December 31, 2026. A new checking account is defined as the member's first consumer checking account with Shell FCU. Earn $250 when the following are met within 90 days of account opening: open a new Checking or eChecking account with a $1 deposit, receive at least $2,000 in consumer Automatic Clearing House (ACH) direct deposits, enroll in eStatements with a valid email address, and access your account in Digital Banking. ACH deposits must be prearranged such as payroll, government benefits or other similar prearranged deposits. ACH deposits originated in Digital Banking or by Shell FCU do not qualify. If warranted, 1099 forms will be issued the following January. Incentives will be withheld for accounts closed within six months.
steps: Confirm Shell FCU membership eligibility (live, work, worship, attend school, or do business in Harris County, TX); membership requires purchasing one $5 share - a refundable retained membership deposit, not a fee (per Shell FCU's Truth-in-Savings: 'you must purchase and maintain the minimum required share(s)... Par Value of One Share $5.00').
Open a new Shell FCU Checking or eChecking account with a $1 deposit (must be your first consumer checking account with Shell FCU).
Within 90 days of account opening: receive at least $2,000 in qualifying consumer ACH direct deposits (payroll, government benefits, or similar prearranged deposits).
Enroll in eStatements with a valid email address and access the account in Digital Banking.
Keep the account open at least six months to avoid the incentive being withheld.
catches: Requires $2,000 in qualifying ACH direct deposits within 90 days - higher than many competing bonuses.
ACH deposits originated in Digital Banking or by Shell FCU itself do not qualify; must be prearranged payroll/government-type deposits.
Incentives withheld for accounts closed within six months - effective 6-month clawback/commitment.
Membership limited to Harris County, TX area (live/work/worship/school/business).
New checking account = member's FIRST consumer checking account with Shell FCU.
Shell FCU may modify or discontinue the promotion without notice.
Membership requires a $5 share purchase - a refundable retained deposit, not an upfront fee.
biggest_catch: $2,000 in qualifying prearranged ACH direct deposits within 90 days is a high bar, and the bonus is withheld if the account is closed within six months.
eligibility: New members in Shell FCU's Harris County, TX field of membership opening their first consumer checking account with the credit union.
timing: Bonus paid after qualification within the 90-day window; incentives withheld for accounts closed within six months of opening.
